quality.missingValuePolicy: SQL NULL stays absent/null. Source zero is retained; no inferred zeros.
quality.previousIndustryRowMissing: No previous industry row is unavailable data, not an assumed zero or confirmed new opening.
quality.populationGrain: floating/resident/worker and all population detail categories describe the region, not an industry.
quality.salesGrain: Estimated quarterly region-by-industry sales, not an individual store actual revenue.
quality.salesMonthlyPerStore: Client-side reference calculation only: quarterly industry sales / 3 / same-industry stores; exact Seoul site formula not established.
quality.sectorAggregation: Industry-sector/all sums must be explicit in the UI; unavailable industry sales are not zero.
